name: binnacle
description: Binnacle's actions: product, daily, task, status, checkpoint and autopilot, driven through the binnacle MCP server, and audit, init, daemon, register and dashboard, which run the binn audit, binn init, binn daemon, binn project register and binn dashboard commands and need no daemon to be started. Init writes only after the human's yes in the chat; registering and the dashboard need a running daemon, which register and dashboard say. dashboard shows the dashboard's address without its token. roadmap turns a vision or a half-built project into a roadmap of epics, writing and committing only after the human's yes and never pushing, with no daemon. help explains in plain words, in the user's language, which skill to use when, and calls no tool. answer, started by a human only, writes the owner's answer to a question an agent recorded in a ticket, on the Task's branch or as an issue comment, and never pushes.
